messages:
Maya: Quick sync — planning to pin model `orion-8b:v2` in the catalog and route ~10% traffic for canary on Tue 2024-03-05 10:00 PT. Need smoke owners, rollback steps confirmed, and a quick CR check on the pinning script.

Dan: I'm available for smoke at 10:00 PT. Can take request/latency checks + prompt sampling.

Priya: I can run the quality evals and check hallucination/regression sets. Will have prompt suite ready by EOD Mon.

Evan: Who's doing the actual pin operation? I can run the pin CLI and monitor the registry update.

Maya: @Evan please do the pin. @Dan smoke, @Priya quality. @Sara can you be on standby for infra rollback?

Sara: Yep. Rollback plan is: 1) revert pin (catalog unpin) 2) promote previous variant (orion-8b:v1) 3) restart routing agent if needed. Estimated 3–5 min ops.

Evan: Command I'll run (dry-run first):

```
redwood catalog pin --model orion-8b:v2 --route api-prod --traffic 0.10 --reason "canary pin 2024-03-05"
redwood catalog verify --model orion-8b:v2 --route api-prod
```

I'll paste the dry-run output here before we flip.

Priya: For quality checks I'll run the dev-suite and a shorter set of high-impact prompts: user-safety, summarize, math. Expect pass/fail within 10m after pin.

Dan: For smoke please check:
- median latency on 1k samples
- tail p95/p99
- token cost per request
- KV cache hit rates
I'll run a quick synthetic load and a small set of real prompts.

Maya: CR: @Evan small PR that updates the catalog pinning docs and adds a flag for --dry-run. Can you paste a link?

Evan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/412 — adds dry-run + safer logging. Approved by me, @Priya can you give a quick look?

Priya: LGTM on doc bits, one comment about the eval reference file path. Will push a tiny change.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance window registered: catalog.pin.orion-8b v2 — 2024-03-05T17:00Z (10:00 PT). Reminder + postmortem template will be created automatically.

Sara: If rollback triggered, I'll run:
```
redwood catalog unpin --model orion-8b:v2 --route api-prod --reason "rollback <ticket>"
redwood routing promote --model orion-8b:v1 --route api-prod
```
And notify on #incidents if >5% error increase.

Maya: OK timeline: Mon EOD — Priya evals ready, Evan dry-run + PR merge. Tue 09:45 PT — final check in this thread. Tue 10:00 PT — do the pin and monitor 30m. If no regressions, we'll ramp to 50% at 11:00 PT.

Dan: I'll start smoke at 10:00 and post results here.

Evan: Dry-run output: success, no conflicts. Will merge PR after Priya's tiny change.

Priya: Change pushed. Approving final PR now.

Maya: Great. Thanks team. Ping here at 09:45 PT for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
